### Data model changes (v1.1.0 → v1.2.0)

**Solutions:** Core 1.0.0.3 → 1.0.0.4 · Sales 2.1

#### Tables

| Change | Table | Details |
|---|---|---|
| Removed | `dvt_invoice` Invoice | 6 columns |

#### Columns

| Change | Table | Column | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| Added | `dvt_project` | `dvt_approverid` Reviewer | lookup (possibly renamed from `dvt_reviewerid`) |
| Added | `dvt_project` | `dvt_code` Code | nvarchar(20) |
| Modified | `dvt_project` | `dvt_name` Title | `displayName`: Name → Title; `required`: required → none |
| Removed | `dvt_project` | `dvt_reviewerid` Reviewer | lookup |
| Removed | `Task` | `dvt_effort` Effort (hours) | int |

#### Choices and status reasons

| Change | Choice | Value | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| Removed | `dvt_invoice_statecode` (dvt_invoice.statecode) |  | 2 values |
| Removed | `dvt_invoice_statuscode` (dvt_invoice.statuscode) |  | 2 values |
| Modified | `dvt_priority` (dvt_project.dvt_priority) |  | `displayName`: Priority → Urgency |
| Modified | `dvt_project_statuscode` (dvt_project.statuscode) | 123450000 Paused | `label`: On Hold → Paused |
| Added | `task_statuscode` (Task.statuscode) | 123450003 Waiting for parts | state 0 |

#### Relationships

| Change | Relationship | Details |
|---|---|---|
| Removed | `dvt_dvt_project_dvt_invoice` | dvt_project.dvt_projectid < dvt_invoice.dvt_projectid |
| Removed | `dvt_project_meeting_reviewers` | dvt_project.dvt_projectid <> dvt_meeting.activityid |
| Modified | `dvt_systemuser_dvt_project_reviewerid` | `endpoints`: SystemUser.systemuserid < dvt_project.dvt_reviewerid → SystemUser.systemuserid < dvt_project.dvt_approverid |

#### Keys

| Change | Table | Key | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| Added | `dvt_project` | `dvt_project_code_key` | dvt_code |

> Dataverse logical names cannot be renamed: possibleRename only means that a removed and an added item share a display name.
